name: add-to-calendar-button
title: Add to calendar button
description: Adds an event to the calendar people use, Google, Outlook, Apple or an .ics file, built from one event object with the time zone handled.
docs: A start without an offset (2026-11-12T19:00) is read in the event's timeZone; a Date or a string ending in Z or +01:00 is an exact moment. Give end or durationMinutes (default 60). All-day events take a date, and end is the last day. buildIcs, buildGoogleUrl and buildOutlookUrl are pure functions in calendar.ts that return null for an event that cannot be read. Pass uid so an edited event updates the first one in the calendar.
